messages:
support_eli: FYI customer @alyssa opened a billing discrepancy. Dashboard shows ~900k tokens for March but invoice (INV-2026-03-11) lists ~1.2M. Ticket #9345. They say our SDK local token estimate differs from the API's usage field. Paste snippets they provided below.

support_eli: customer sample (redacted):
```
// client-side estimate using our JS helper
const parts = [systemPrompt, userPrompt, toolPrompt];
const clientEstimate = estimateTokens(parts, {model: 'redwood-4x'}); // returns 350
await redwood.responses.create(...)
// API returned:
"usage": { "prompt_tokens": 300, "completion_tokens": 40, "total_tokens": 340 }
```
They see clientEstimate=350 vs invoice-aggregated totals aligned with server total_tokens.

billing_jamie: Thanks — can you add invoice id + a couple example x-request-id values and account id? Is this a single high-volume integration or many small calls? Also confirm SDK version. Invoices can include post-processed tokens (batching/concatenation) so we need examples.

support_eli: Invoice INV-2026-03-11, acct: acct_7hzQ, example request ids: rq_01G9X1A2, rq_01G9X1A5. Customer says they use redwood-js v0.9.2 and our estimate helper before sending. They also do streaming and some function/tool calls.

eng_ml_sree: Quick notes from infra/ML side: common mismatch sources — server-side normalization of system messages (we may add implicit system tokens for safety), function_call args and tool outputs can be encoded differently on the server, and streaming vs finalization timing (dashboard sampling can lag). Also different tokenizer variants depending on model alias (redwood-4x vs redwood-4x-turbo). Do we have the raw request payloads + x-request-id headers? Need them to reproduce.

devex_marc: Also check whether client estimate used the same tokenizer/encoding parameters (e.g., allowed_specials, chat vs text encoding). Our client helper intentionally excludes certain invisible assistant tokens that the server adds (e.g., internal provenance markers). We have an internal debug endpoint for tokenization parity (/internal/debug/tokens) — if we can run the exact payload there we can compare tokenization on both sides.

customer_alyssa: I can share raw curl from our proxy, but can't post full PII here. Example (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: rq_01G9X1A2" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4x","input":[{"role":"system","content":"<long system blob>"},{"role":"user","content":"short prompt"}], "stream": true}'
```
We also call a function that returns a ~5KB json blob which we then feed back into the prompt as a tool result. Could that be double-counted?

eng_ml_sree: Good detail — tool outputs returned by the assistant are counted in different places depending on workflow. If you pipe a tool result back into a new request as a user message (prefixed), that will be counted again on the next request. On the server we may compress or trim repeated metadata before counting for dashboards, but invoices use the canonical finalized tokens after pipeline joins. Possible causes: (1) client counting the original tool payload + server counting the same payload once more after canonicalization, (2) different tokenizer variant/encoding mismatch, (3) dashboard sampling lag under streaming.

billing_jamie: For top-level billing process: invoices are authoritative. We can hold adjustments while eng reproduces. Please provide the list of affected dates, sample request bodies, and the full invoice IDs. We'll create an internal billing review once eng confirms root cause.

support-bot: Note added to ticket #9345: escalated to eng-ml + billing. Diagnostic logging enabled for acct_7hzQ for 24h.

support_eli: Action list for now: 1) @customer_alyssa please upload 2-3 raw request bodies + x-request-id headers to the ticket (redact secrets) 2) @eng_ml_sree + @devex_marc run payloads through /internal/debug/tokens and compare to client estimate helper + server usage field 3) @billing_jamie hold invoice adjustments pending findings.

customer_alyssa: Will attach the payloads and curl logs in the ticket by EOD. One more datapoint: our local tiktoken-based estimator gives a higher count when we include system instructions and prior tool results inline — that was why we started pre-estimating tokens to gate request size.

eng_ml_sree: Thanks. If we find tokenizer mismatch, short-term workaround is to use server-side /v1/responses/tokens-preview (or ask us to enable the internal debug endpoint for the account) to get server-aligned counts before sending. Long-term we'll add an opt-in client flag to mirror server tokenization precisely.

billing_jamie: Noted. I'll wait for the sample rqs and dates. If invoice adjustments are needed we'll follow billing policy and document the reconciliation.

support_eli: Closing loop here in the channel — ticket updated with next steps. :thumbsup:
